Odyssey world viewer

Maps from the 10,000-year n48 run (seed 1). Each pixel is one degree and shows the nearest model tile, about 150 km wide. Pick a layer and compare the start of the free run with its end.

Move over the map to read a value.

Ten thousand years, both seeds

seed 1seed 2

What this is not. The world starts from today's coasts, today's ice sheets and today's observed climate, run with the orbit of the start year. It is not the real world of 12,000 BC. Sea level is not 60 m lower, Doggerland and Beringia are under water, and the Laurentide ice remnant is missing. Rain and temperature still follow today's maps. Treat the pictures as a check on the engine, not a reconstruction. All snapshots are taken in January.
